plugins.name: AlembicImporter
plugins.description: Imports Alembic (.abc, Ogawa) caches as source models: transforms, polygon meshes, cameras, and animated point caches baked into per-frame vertex animation. Needs the Alembic library; without it .abc files are refused with a message. Editor only: games ship the cooked result.

plugins.name: AntiCheatReference
plugins.description: A managed server-authority anti-cheat service for the engine's IAntiCheatService seam: a challenge handshake over the net channel, movement and message-rate validation, input-replay verification hooks and a ban list. No client agent and no kernel component. Pair it with Project Settings > Anti-Cheat to refuse untrusted clients.

plugins.name: ArenaKit
plugins.description: Team deathmatch rules for a multiplayer arena shooter on the Combat weapons and the session layer: match phases (warmup, live, results), two teams, spawn selection, respawns, scoring, navigation-driven bots, a replicated match state the HUD and scoreboard bind to, and optional hooks into replays, matchmaking and anti-cheat when those are present. The Arena Shooter sample enables it.

plugins.name: Combat
plugins.description: Ranged and melee combat with weapon/item definitions, carry and throw, E-to-interact with focus highlight, inventory, crafting stations, gameplay zones, the utility grid and RPG progression - with their placeable actors, serializers, HUD binding sources and Visual Script statics. Registers everything through the engine modular seams when its module loads.

plugins.name: DiscordPlatform
plugins.description: Discord Social SDK integration: rich presence and the per-frame callback pump. Registers a presence-only IOnlineService through the engine seam when its module loads; the project's platform.discordEnabled/discordApplicationId settings bring it up.

plugins.name: EditorUtility
plugins.description: Automate the editor from scripts: MFUNCTION(CallInEditor) buttons in Details for any actor or component, Visual Scripting editor-utility classes (AEditorUtilityActor, in C++ or Visual Scripting) that run in the open level inside one undo step, Tools > Run Script, Content Browser Run on selection, and a node library over the editor automation commands. Errors land on the Message Log's Scripts page. Editor only: it never loads in a game or a server.

plugins.name: EosPlatform
plugins.description: Epic Online Services integration: product-user sign-in (device identity, or the Epic account when launched from the Epic Games Store), lobbies and session adverts, stats, achievements, leaderboards, friends and presence, Connect ID tokens and cloud saves through Player Data Storage. Registers an IOnlineService through the engine seam when its module loads; the project's platform.eosEnabled and EOS id settings bring it up. The EOS SDK is not shipped with the engine: drop it into Engine/Source/ThirdParty/EOSSDK.

plugins.name: GameplayData
plugins.description: An editor panel for the data side of gameplay: every Game Feature with its state, dependencies and blocked reason and buttons to activate, deactivate, enable and disable it, and every Data Registry with its sources and items, loadable on demand. Editor only.

plugins.name: HorrorKit
plugins.description: First-person horror gameplay: a survivor with a flickering flashlight and a click, a stalker that follows the noise you make and catches you at arm's length (the fail state: a stinger, a flashlight blackout and a respawn), and solo and co-op game modes that register the survivor with the network session. The Horror template enables it.

plugins.name: LightmapBaker
plugins.description: Bakes the static indirect and direct diffuse light of a level into BC6H lightmap atlases that the Low quality tier samples instead of dynamic Global Illumination. Adds Build > Bake Lighting and a toolbar button to the editor, with progress and cancel. Editor only: the baked files ship, the baker does not.

plugins.name: MowoMatchmaking
plugins.description: Matchmaking against the self-hostable MowoMatchmaker (Engine/Source/Programs/MowoMatchmaker): the IMatchmakingService that creates, polls and cancels tickets over HTTP, and the allocator client that lets MowoServer --allocator register with the matchmaker, report its state and take allocations. The matchmaker address is Project Settings > Engine > Matchmaking (net.mm.Url).

plugins.name: MowoOnlinePlatform
plugins.description: Mowo Online Services through the Mowo Games Launcher (MOS SDK, mos_sdk): Mowo ID identity and token, friends and presence, invites and join requests, achievements, cloud saves of the SaveGames folder and the launcher overlay over the game window. Registers an IOnlineService through the engine seam when its module loads; the project's platform.mowoOnlineEnabled/mowoProductId settings bring it up.

plugins.name: PlatformerKit
plugins.description: A plane-locked side-scroller character: run along one axis, coyote time, a double jump, a held-jump height, a fixed side camera and a respawn under the level. The 2D Platformer template enables it; place or subclass APlatformerCharacter in any project.

plugins.name: Replay
plugins.description: Records a match as a chunked, compressed .mreplay file with checkpoints, plays it back in a separate spectator world with seek, speed and pause, adds read-only spectator slots with free, follow and orbit cameras, and a kill-cam that replays the last seconds from the killer's side. Visual Scripting nodes drive all of it.

plugins.name: ScanHierarchy
plugins.description: Casts LiDAR scanner shots against an Embree bounding-volume hierarchy built from the level's render triangles, with moving bodies and bone capsules re-posed every frame, in parallel across the job system. Without it the scanner traces the Jolt colliders on the game thread. Adds about 6.8 MB of Embree to a packaged game, so it is off unless the project enables it.

plugins.name: SmartProps
plugins.description: Parametric, non-destructive prop assemblies authored as .mprop assets: typed parameters, weighted variants, expression-driven parts, tagged sockets, placement rules and spline/volume/socket scatter. Instances regenerate deterministically from a seed and never write their parts into the scene until baked. Registers its scene system and .mprop serializer when its module loads.

plugins.name: Sprites2D
plugins.description: The 2D runtime and tools: sprite, flipbook, tileset, tilemap and sprite atlas assets, batched sprite rendering with sorting layers, chunked tile layers with auto-tiling, parallax and a following pixel-perfect camera, 2D colliders on the XY plane, tilemap collision from tile flags and the Sprite Editor, Tile Palette and Move 2D editor tools.

plugins.name: SteamPlatform
plugins.description: Steamworks online-platform integration: identity, SDR P2P transport, lobbies and invites, rich presence, stats/achievements, encrypted session tickets and cloud save files. Registers an IOnlineService through the engine seam when its module loads; the project's platform.steamEnabled/steamAppId settings bring it up.

plugins.name: StrategyKit
plugins.description: Real-time-strategy control: an RTS camera pawn (pan, edge pan, rotate, zoom), click and box selection of placed strategy units, and move orders issued to the selection through the navigation agents in a formation. The Strategy template enables it.

plugins.name: Survival
plugins.description: Base building (placement/demolish modes with catalog and affordability), the currency/trade economy with shops, their .mbuildable/.mshop assets, the template characters' build-mode input as a registered character extension, and the Visual Script statics surface.

plugins.name: UsdImporter
plugins.description: Imports Universal Scene Description files (.usd, .usda, .usdc, .usdz) as source models: meshes with subsets, the prim hierarchy, native instances and point instancers, UsdPreviewSurface materials, cameras, lights, skeletons with skinning and animation clips. Binary USD needs the OpenUSD library; ASCII .usda also imports without it. Editor only: games ship the cooked result.

plugins.name: VehicleKit
plugins.description: Arcade driving for the Vehicle physics component: drive input with reverse-aware braking and speed-sensitive steering, a chase camera, and a game mode that puts the player in the vehicle placed in the level, and a time trial mode with race checkpoints, laps and a timer for the HUD. The Vehicle template enables it.

plugins.name: VisualLogger
plugins.description: An editor panel for the Visual Logger: the categorised text and debug shapes game code records with MOWO_VLOG, scrubbed back frame by frame on a timeline, filtered by category, verbosity and text, with the shapes of the scrubbed frame drawn in the viewport. Editor only; the recording calls in game code cost one atomic load when nothing records.

plugins.name: VoxelKit
plugins.description: A placeable voxel world: seeded heightmap terrain generated in chunks, previewed live in the editor viewport, meshed into the engine's packed voxel vertex pool and given voxel colliders in play. The Voxel template enables it.

templates.name: TP_Blank
templates.subtitle: Empty level, no code
templates.description: A truly empty world with no actors and no gameplay code wired, for building everything from scratch.

templates.name: TP_FirstPerson
templates.subtitle: Walk, sprint, crouch, interact
templates.description: A first-person starter set in a sci-fi apartment and lab: an animated Quaternius body you can see when you look down, footstep sounds, carryable crates, an item pickup and a sliding lab door. Start as a walking sim or add a pistol and target range.

templates.name: TP_Horror
templates.subtitle: Dark sci-fi facility, flashlight, a stalker that listens
templates.description: A first-person horror game in a dark sci-fi facility: textured corridors, lockers and labs lit by failing lamps and volumetric haze, a flashlight you switch on and off, and a stalker that finds you by the noise you make. Play alone, or switch to the co-op variant for two to four survivors.

templates.name: TP_Platformer2D
templates.subtitle: Coins, slimes and a goal flag, tilemap level
templates.description: A side-scrolling platformer on Kenney art: a tilemap level with auto-tiled ground, floating platforms and collision from tile flags, a parallax backdrop, an animated sprite character with idle, run, jump and fall states, coins to collect, patrolling slimes to stomp, a goal flag, a HUD and an orthographic camera that follows the player. The movement, coins, enemies and goal come from the Platformer Kit plugin; the 2D runtime and tools come from the 2D Sprites and Tilemaps plugin.

templates.name: TP_ThirdPerson
templates.subtitle: Superhero character, full animation set, urban plaza
templates.description: A ready-to-play third-person starter: a Quaternius superhero with a locomotion, jump, crouch and interact animation graph, a follow camera, a dressed plaza with PBR materials and props, footsteps and ambience, a one-objective quest and an NPC on a daily schedule.

templates.name: TP_TopDown
templates.subtitle: Fixed-camera yard, zombies that hunt by sound
templates.description: A top-down action starter: a Quaternius hero under a fixed camera, a walled prototype-tile yard with Zombie Kit cover, five supply crates to collect and four zombies that hunt what they hear. Everything plays on engine classes, Visual Scripting and the shared content packs, so it runs with no compile.

templates.name: TP_Vehicle
templates.subtitle: Race car, circuit, checkpoints and a lap timer
templates.description: A driving starter: a Kenney race car on the engine vehicle component with real suspension, a Racing Kit circuit with four checkpoint gates, a three lap timer with best lap, a speed and camera HUD, chase, far and bumper cameras and a respawn on R. It plays on the Vehicle Kit plugin with no compile.
